caption:
HOW WE BUILT THIS TEAM 🎮🦖 4 trades, 4 free-agent catches, 4 draft eggs.

🔄 Trade machine: OG to New York for RJ + Quickley (Dec 2023), Poeltl back from San Antonio (Feb 2023), Shead from Sacramento on draft night (2024), Ingram + Gradey + 5 picks for Kawhi (Sept 2026)
🏀 Caught: Jamison Battle (undrafted, 2024), Kyle Anderson (1 year), Quickley re-signed (5 years, $175M), Poeltl extended (4 years, $104M)
🥚 Draft eggs: Scottie (No. 4, 2021), CMB (No. 9, 2025), Ja'Kobe Walter (No. 19, 2024), Allen Graves (No. 19, 2026)

We're 5-5. Who's your favorite pickup? 👇

beats.vo: December twenty twenty-three. We sent OG Anunoby to New York for RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley.
February twenty twenty-three. Jakob Poeltl came home from San Antonio for Khem Birch, a first and two seconds.
Draft night twenty twenty-four. Jamal Shead came over from Sacramento.
This September: Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick and five picks to the Clippers for Kawhi Leonard.

facts.claim: On December 30, 2023, the Knicks traded RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley (with a 2024 second-round pick) to the Toronto Raptors for OG Anunoby, Precious Achiuwa and Malachi Flynn

On February 9, 2023, Pöltl was traded back to the Toronto Raptors in exchange for Khem Birch, a 2024 first-round pick (1ST), a 2023 second-round pick and a 2025 second-round pick (2 2NDS). On July 7, 2025 he signed a 4-year (4Y, 4 YEARS), $104 million ($104M) extension
In the 2024 NBA draft Shead was selected 45th by Sacramento and traded on draft night (with Davion Mitchell, Aleksandar Vezenkov and a 2025 second-round pick) to Toronto for Jalen McDaniels
On September 14, 2026, Ingram was traded to the Clippers along with Gradey Dick and five (5) draft picks in exchange for Leonard
After going undrafted in the 2024 NBA draft, Battle signed with the Toronto Raptors on July 16, 2024
On July 2, 2026, Anderson signed a one-year (1 YEAR) minimum (MIN) deal with the Toronto Raptors
On July 8, 2024, Quickley re-signed on a 5-year (5Y, 5 YEARS), $175 million ($175M) contract to remain with the Raptors
Collin Murray-Boyles chosen #9 (ninth overall) in the 2025 NBA draft by Toronto
June 26, 2024: Ja'Kobe Walter selected #19 (19th overall) by Toronto
June 23, 2026: Allen Graves drafted #19 (19th overall) by Toronto
Reel counts: 4 trades, 4 free-agent catches, 4 draft eggs; 2026-27 roster (THE 2026-27 RAPTORS); Raptors 5-5 after 10 games
